chunks: They are those who were condemned by God, whose ears were blocked by Him and their eyes blinded.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun referring to a specific group)

ai.seo_question: Who are the people cursed by Allah whose ears and eyes are blinded?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *baqa'* (permanence) of the seal, where prolonged rejection of the Imams and the Prophet solidifies into a permanent spiritual blindness. It highlights the divine consequence of *kufn* (disbelief) not merely as a lack of knowledge, but as an active obstruction of the faculties of hearing and sight, rendering the individual incapable of perceiving the truth even when presented. This condition is viewed as a just recompense for their willful turning away from the light of guidance.
